title_en: FOX, NYRA Expand Broadcasts With Compelling Stories
description: With FanDuel TV downsizing, FOX and NYRA have begun to expand their broadcasts with more tracks, seeking the ones that are offering premium races and compelling stories.

title_en: Caldwell Retires After 52 Years with Keeneland Sales
description: Auctioneer Scott Caldwell has retired after 52 years at Keeneland, closing a chapter of a family association with the sales company that began in the 1950s with his late father, Tom, and included his late brother, Cris.

title_en: Three-Time Group 1 Winner Al Riffa Retired at Age 6
description: The son of Wootton Bassett won five times, three of which came at the top level, and ran to a high level across the world, including in France, Germany, Hong Kong, Australia, and Saudi Arabia.

title_en: Catalog for Fasig-Tipton's Saratoga Fall Mixed Online
description: Fasig-Tipton has cataloged 308 entries for its Saratoga Fall Mixed Sale, to be held Oct. 12 in Saratoga Springs, N.Y. The sale will be conducted in the Humphrey S. Finney Pavilion beginning at 10 a.m. ET.

title_en: Diamond Rain Back to Avenge E. P. Taylor Defeat
description: Second in the race last year, Diamond Rain is back in search of victory Sept. 12 in the CA$750,000 E. P. Taylor Stakes (G1T) at Woodbine.

title_en: Woodbine Mile Welcomes Notable Speech, Deterministic
description: Racing will treat fans to a showdown Sept. 12 when reigning champion Turf Male Notable Speech (GB) attempts to defend his title in the CA$1 million Woodbine Mile (G1T) where he will face this year's leading North American turf miler, Deterministic.

title_en: Trio of European Runners Look Tough in Summer
description: Three stakes-proven European runners, led by group 2 winner Al Hudaiba, appear the horses to beat Sept. 12 in the CA$500,000 Summer Stakes (G1T) at Woodbine.

title_en: At a Glance Handicapping Preview of Iroquois Stakes
description: The Iroquois Stakes (G3) at Churchill Downs kicks off the slate of points races to earn a spot in the starting gate for the 2027 Kentucky Derby (G1), the opening leg of next year's Triple Crown.

title_en: Ombudsman's Half Sister Added to Tatts Online Sale
description: A total of 195 lots have been cataloged for the Tattersalls Online September Sale, with the auction featuring horses in and out of training, breeding stock, youngstock and breeding rights, headlined by Ombudsman's half sister American Belle.

title_en: Raybiya Added to Tattersalls Sceptre Session Lineup
description: Regally bred mare Raybiya, a half sister to this year's group 1-winning French Two Thousand Guineas (G1) hero Rayif, has been added to the exciting lineup for this year's Tattersalls December Mares Sale.

title_en: Pershaada Has Breeders' Cup Audition in Flying Childers
description: Pershaada could put herself in line for a trip to the Breeders' Cup with a return to winning ways in the Flying Childers Stakes (G2) Sept. 11 at Doncaster.

title_en: Todaro Runners Tie as Emerald Downs Horses of the Meet
description: In an Emerald Downs' first, 6-year-old mare Aloha Breeze and 3-year-old colt Robin Racer have been voted co-Horses of the Meeting at the 47-day season that concluded Sept. 7.

title_en: Franco's Spa Crown Capped with Jockey of the Week Honor
description: Franco clinched the leading rider title at Saratoga for the first time in his career with a win in the Prioress Stakes (G3). Then, to put an exclamation point on the day, he added the Hopeful Stakes (G1), Saratoga's premier race for 2-year-olds.

title_en: Ka Ying Rising Opens Lead in Longines World Rankings
description: Following a record-setting performance to kick off the Hong Kong season in the Chief Executive's Cup (G3) Sept. 6 at Sha Tin, Ka Ying Rising now stands alone as the top-rated horse in the world in the Longines World's Best Racehorse Rankings.

title_en: Prat, Maker Win Meet Titles at Kentucky Downs
description: Reigning Eclipse champion jockey Flavien Prat secured his first Kentucky Downs riding title at the 2026 meet, while Kentucky Downs' all-time leading trainer Mike Maker collected his eighth meet title.

title_en: Handicapping Downhill Turf Sprints at Santa Anita
description: In the latest edition of the Odds and Trends column, as the Santa Anita Park autumn meet begins Sept. 25, J. Keeler Johnson takes a look at different betting angles for the track's unique downhill turf course.

title_en: Exline-Border Racing Aims for Another High-Value Upset
description: It would be a surprise if any horse other than Notable Speech or Deterministic wins the Woodbine Mile (G1T), but Exline-Border Racing and its partners have pulled off notable surprises before. They run Gas Me Up in the Breeders' Cup qualifier.

title_en: Kentucky Belle Right at Home in Dueling Grounds Oaks
description: On Sept. 9 at Kentucky Downs, Flavien Prat won six of the day's 14 races, topped by Kentucky Belle in the $1,995,000 Dueling Grounds Oaks Invitational Stakes (G3T).

title_en: Salahudin Heads Iroquois as Derby Points Series Begins
description: Six-time Kentucky Derby (G1)-winning trainer Bob Baffert, who has maintained a full-time string in Kentucky since the spring, has the Iroquois Stakes (G3) favorite in Zedan Racing Stables' Salahudin.

title_en: Officials Praise Safety Numbers at Saratoga Meet
description: While the New York Racing Association staged its longest meet at Saratoga Race Course this summer, it also proved to be one of the safest in the iconic racetrack's 163-year history.

title_en: Will Simply Joking Deny Joseph Fourth Princess Rooney?
description: Grade 1-placed Simply Joking comes east for the first time in almost a year with designs set on the Sept. 12 Princess Rooney Stakes (G3) at Gulfstream Park.

title_en: Gonzales Calls 45-Day Suspension of Barocio Too Lenient
description: During an otherwise uneventful Sept. 9 meeting of the California Horse Racing Board, vice chair Oscar Gonzales expresses disappointment with what he considers an insufficient 45-day suspension issued by HISA to California trainer Librado Barocio.

title_en: Mehmas Filly Shines at Osarus La Teste Yearling Sale
description: A sole member of the catalog by box-office stallion Mehmas became the most expensive lot to be traded at the Osarus La Teste Yearling Sale since 2019 when bought by Spanish-based interests.

title_en: Academic Skills Class Launched for Jockeys
description: The Jockeys' Guild Education Foundation and Bluegrass Community and Technical College have launched an online course to help jockeys build academic skills, strengthen digital literacy, and prepare for future career-specific educational opportunities.

title_en: Bellatrix Star Tops Inglis Australia Digital Sale
description: An ecstatic John Galvin of Fortuna Racing was "blown away'' and "thrilled'' with the sale of his high-class race filly Bellatrix Star, who topped the Inglis Digital Australia September (Early) Sale at AU$900,000.

title_en: Take Charge Star to Race Next in Breeders' Cup
description: The Breeders' Cup is next on the agenda for the Johnny Murtagh-trained Take Charge Star after the colt earned a big payday when bolting up in the Franklin-Simpson Stakes (G2T) Sept. 7 at Kentucky Downs under Jamie Spencer.

title_en: Four-Time Group 1 Winner Fangirl Retired
description: Four-time group 1 winner Fangirl has been retired following her third-place finish in the Chelmsford Stakes (G2) Sept. 5 at Randwick Racecourse. The 8-year-old bows out having won 12 of her 42 starts, and prize money exceeding AU$11 million.

title_en: HISA Defends Handling of Gramm Case in Letter to FTC
description: Noting it has taken responsibility for a data breach involving horse owner Marshall Gramm, HISA outlined a number of steps it has taken to address the vulnerability in a Sept. 9 letter to the Federal Trade Commission.

title_en: Travers Winner Leading Change Joins NTRA Top 10
description: There was no change to the leaders of the National Thoroughbred Racing Association's Top Thoroughbred Poll released Sept. 9, but some shuffling did occur at the bottom of the top 10.

title_en: Kentucky Derby Points Race Highlights Radio, TV Slate
description: A schedule of this week's racing on radio, television, and streaming schedule compiled by America's Best Racing.

title_en: Thoroughbred Meet at Los Alamitos Starts Sept. 11
description: The September Thoroughbred meet at Los Alamitos will begin Sept. 11, while the six-day season will continue through Sept. 20 with racing conducted on Friday-Sunday both weeks (Sept. 11-13 and 18-20). Post time will be 1 p.m. local time.

title_en: Sovereignty No. 1 in Breeders' Cup Classic Rankings
description: The top five positions in the latest Longines Breeders' Cup Classic Rankings remain unchanged with Whitney Stakes (G1) winner Sovereignty still leading the way with 24 first-place votes and 383 total.

title_en: Forever Young Arrives in NY for Jockey Club Gold Cup
description: While reigning Horse of the Year Sovereignty's participation in the Sept. 18 Jockey Club Gold Cup (G1) remains in doubt, Japanese star Forever Young is on course to start in the $1 million race at Belmont Park.

title_en: Group 1-Winning Sprinter Powerful Glory Retired
description: Powerful Glory, last year's 200-1 winner of the British Champions Sprint Stakes (G1), has been retired from racing, with no plans confirmed for the 4-year-old son of Cotai Glory.

title_en: Freshman Sires Dominate Labor Day Weekend Stakes
description: In this week's Porter on Pedigrees, Alan Porter examines the success of the 2026 freshman sires class. Not only did two of the four juvenile grade 1 events on offer fall to freshman sires, but four more also added stakes winners to their resumes.

title_en: Imperial Honor, Dargham, Hemingway Win Smartly
description: Juveniles Imperial Honor, Dargham, and Hemingway are BloodHorse Maiden Watch Hot Prospects after scoring emphatic recent victories.

title_en: Progeny Winning Big-Purse Grade 2s Aid Sires' Ranking
description: As stallions move up and down the rankings based on progeny earnings, it's not only the big grade 1 races that provide them a boost. As the last two weeks have shown, big-money grade 2 races are just as effective.

title_en: Vanta First Stakes Winner for Sire Greatest Honour
description: Greatest Honour, a grade 2 winner and grade 1-placed, saw his first black-type stakes winner Sept. 6 when Vanta captured the Del Mar Juvenile Fillies Turf Stakes.

description: Japan-based dual grade 1-winning sprinter Satono Reve has been retired from racing and will stand at Shadai Stallion Station in Japan for 2027, trainer Noriyuki Hori announced Sept. 7.

title_en: Owner, Breeder Lunsford Dies at 78
description: Lunsford is best known in racing circles for campaigning grade 1 winners Art Collector and Madcap Escapade.

title_en: Graded Success for Flightline's Shonan Galleon in Japan

title_en: Glycogen First Stakes Winner for Jack Christopher
description: Glycogen produces the needed late energy to rally to victory in the Sept. 4 P. G. Johnson Stakes for 2-year-old fillies at Saratoga Race Course.

description: The Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe (G1) will be open to geldings beginning next year after the European Pattern Committee approved France Galop's decision to remove the restriction on one of the world's greatest races.

title_en: O'Sullivan Farms Stallion My Prankster Dies at Age 7
description: My Prankster, the grade 3-winning son of Into Mischief who stood at O'Sullivan Farms near Charles Town, W.Va., died Sept. 3 at age 7, the farm announced. No cause of death was given.

description: Town & Country Horse Farms has enjoyed each step forward by homebred Mondogetsbuckets. Should he secure a big win at Kentucky Downs, he could earn the owner a Breeders' Cup start at Keeneland, where their Stopchargingmaria won the 2015 Distaff (G1).

description: Trainer Todd Pletcher played a huge role in helping Life Is Good become one of the best runners in his crop. Now Pletcher can give Life Is Good's stallion career a big boost.

description: Running just like his sire, Wood Island gave Jackie's Warrior his first stakes winner in the Skidmore Stakes Aug. 27, fittingly at Saratoga Race Course where the champion sprinter did his best work.

description: The gray or roan filly wins her racing debut by 5 1/4 lengths at Colonial Downs for owners Bowen Thoroughbred Racing and the Estate of Brereton C. Jones.

description: Champion sprinter and prominent sire Orientate was euthanized Aug. 17 at Gainesway Farm due to the infirmities of old age. He was 28.

description: Kentucky-bred Iron Man Cal, a son of Collected, will contest the $250,000 Pat O'Brien Stakes (G2) at Del Mar, a Breeders' Cup Challenge Series: Win and You're In race awarding a free spot in the Breeders' Cup Dirt Mile (G1).
